chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from Salih Al-Hazza', from Yaqub ibn Shu'ayb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When it is the Day of Judgment, a cover from the covers of Paradise will be lifted, and its scent will be smelled by anyone who has a soul from a distance of five hundred years' journey, except for one type. I said, 'Who are they?' He said, 'The one ungrateful to his parents.'
ai.seo_question: Who is excluded from smelling the fragrance of Paradise on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) illustrates the profound spiritual weight of filial piety by noting that the fragrance of Paradise will be perceptible to all souls from a distance of five hundred years' journey, except for the 'al-'aqq' (the disobedient/ungrateful) to their parents. This specific exclusion underscores the unique severity of ingratitude towards parents in Shia tradition, distinguishing it from other sins due to the direct link between parental rights and divine pleasure.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassn Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Salih Al Haza’a, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When it will be the Day of Judgment, a cover from the covers of the Paradise would be uncovered, so its aroma would be smelt by the one who has a soul for him, from a travel distance of five hundred years, except for one type (of person)’. I said, ‘Who are they?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one ungrateful to his parents’.
en.sarwar: 3. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufi from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Salih al-Hadhdha’ from Ya’qub ibn Shu’ayb from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When it will be the Day of Judgment a curtain of the curtains of paradise will rise and everything with a spirit will sense its fragrance from a distance of a five hundred years journey except one group of people.’ I (the narrator) has said that then asked, ‘Who is that group?’ The Imam said, ‘It is those who cause suffering and disappointments to their parents. ’”
